colleges.name: Trinity
colleges.delivery: UK school or college: in person. Overseas: choice of online or in person. UK school leavers ordinarily resident in the UK normally attend in person.
colleges.structure: One 45-minute interview with two mathematicians, following a 60-minute written test. The discussion draws partly on your test work. No books, notes or calculator in the test.
colleges.note: The October 2026 applicant notes give 45 minutes; the subject page gives approximately 40 to 45. Online applicants need the specified writing and scanning setup.

colleges.name: Christ’s
colleges.delivery: Online, using Microsoft Teams.
colleges.structure: Two interviews, normally 35 to 50 minutes in total, typically covering pure and applied maths. A 40-minute invigilated problem sheet precedes one interview; no calculator.
colleges.note: The college calls the problem sheet interview preparation and separately says there is no College assessment. This is not a separately registered admissions test.

colleges.name: Churchill
colleges.delivery: In person, including overseas applicants. Exceptional remote arrangements may be considered.
colleges.structure: The current maths page does not specify the interview count, duration or a preparation task. General college guidance says most applicants have one interview of 30 to 40 minutes.
colleges.note: The timing is college-wide, not confirmed specifically for Mathematics. An older aptitude-test PDF is still online, but the current maths page does not identify it as the current interview test.

colleges.name: Clare
colleges.delivery: Online for Mathematics.
colleges.structure: Maths-specific interview count, duration and any preparation task are not published in the current guidance reviewed.
colleges.note: Medicine and Music have different delivery arrangements. Those exceptions do not apply to Mathematics.

colleges.name: Corpus Christi
colleges.delivery: UK: in person. Overseas: online. Republic of Ireland: choice.
colleges.structure: A problem sheet may be provided immediately before the interview. The current maths page does not state a duration or interview count.

colleges.name: Downing
colleges.delivery: Online for all applicants.
colleges.structure: Two 25-minute interviews on the same day, one pure and one applied. The college publishes sample interview questions; a timed preparation task is not specified in current guidance.
colleges.note: The linked PDF is labelled sample interview questions on the current course page. Do not infer a current 30-minute test from older preparation guides.

colleges.name: Emmanuel
colleges.delivery: In person, including overseas applicants. Exceptional remote arrangements may be considered.
colleges.structure: Normally two maths interviews, approximately 30 minutes each, using unfamiliar questions and discussion. A separate preparation task is not specified.
colleges.note: This uses the maths subject page. The shorter timing on the general college interview page is not used.

colleges.name: Fitzwilliam
colleges.delivery: Online.
colleges.structure: Normally two maths interviews of approximately 20 minutes each. A separate preparation task is not specified.

colleges.name: Girton
colleges.delivery: Online.
colleges.structure: Two interviews with mathematical problems to attempt during the discussion. Duration and any separate preparation task are not specified.

colleges.name: Gonville & Caius
colleges.delivery: UK or Ireland school: choice of in person or online. Overseas school: online.
colleges.structure: Usually two maths interviews of about 30 minutes each, discussing mathematical problems. A separate preparation task is not specified.
colleges.note: Eligibility is phrased by school location on the current-applicant page. Ask the college about unusual circumstances.

colleges.name: Homerton
colleges.delivery: UK school, or UK-resident school leaver: choice of in person or online. Overseas: online.
colleges.structure: Two maths interviews. General college guidance gives about 25 minutes each. The December 2026 maths table explicitly says there is no pre-interview reading or task.
colleges.note: The duration comes from college-wide guidance. The maths-specific applicant table confirms two interviews and no preparation task.

colleges.name: Hughes Hall
colleges.delivery: Online. Mature college: normally 21 or over at entry.
colleges.structure: The current subject guidance does not publish a maths-specific interview count, duration or preparation task.
colleges.note: The general interview page still describes the previous admissions cycle, so its timings are not presented here as current maths arrangements.

sources.title: What to expect at your Cambridge interview

colleges.name: Jesus
colleges.delivery: UK residents: in person. Overseas residents: online.
colleges.structure: One or two maths interviews, lasting 35 to 50 minutes in total, with at least three subject specialists across the interview process. A separate preparation task is not specified.

colleges.name: King’s
colleges.delivery: In person, including overseas applicants. Remote interviews only in exceptional circumstances.
colleges.structure: Two maths interviews, each about 20 to 25 minutes, usually with two interviewers. A separate preparation task is not specified.

colleges.name: Lucy Cavendish
colleges.delivery: Online.
colleges.structure: The maths page describes typically one interview of 40 to 45 minutes. General college guidance gives a different structure; confirm your invitation. Preparatory material may be provided.
colleges.note: The general page describes two interviews of 20 to 30 minutes. The subject-specific guidance is shown, with the discrepancy flagged. The practice pack is not a specimen timed assessment.

colleges.name: Magdalene
colleges.delivery: Online.
colleges.structure: Two maths interviews, each about 20 to 25 minutes. A separate preparation task is not specified in current guidance.

colleges.name: Murray Edwards
colleges.delivery: Online.
colleges.structure: The reviewed current pages do not specify maths interview count, duration or a preparation task.

colleges.name: Newnham
colleges.delivery: Online, using Zoom.
colleges.structure: The maths subject page does not specify interview count, duration or a preparation task. The current applicant page requires an online whiteboard for Mathematics.

colleges.name: Pembroke
colleges.delivery: UK: in person. Overseas: normally online, with an in-person option on request.
colleges.structure: Applicants work on questions before the interview and discuss them with interviewers. The current maths page does not publish the task duration or interview count.

colleges.name: Peterhouse
colleges.delivery: UK school or UK-resident school leaver: in person. Overseas: online.
colleges.structure: One longer maths interview, preceded by roughly 45 to 60 minutes working on preparation questions. The subject page does not specify interview duration.
colleges.note: The maths-specific description takes precedence over the older general college page, which describes two interviews.

colleges.name: Queens’
colleges.delivery: Online.
colleges.structure: The current maths and application pages do not specify maths interview count, duration or preparation tasks.
colleges.note: Use the current application timeline. The separate generic interviews page still refers to the previous cycle.

colleges.name: Robinson
colleges.delivery: UK or Common Travel Area, including Ireland: in person. Elsewhere: online.
colleges.structure: The maths guidance, last updated July 2025, describes two subject interviews of about 30 minutes each. Confirm current timings in your invitation. A separate preparation task is not specified.
colleges.note: The maths timing page was last updated in July 2025. Delivery is checked against December 2026 guidance; confirm current timings in your invitation.

colleges.name: St Catharine’s
colleges.delivery: Online.
colleges.structure: The reviewed maths page does not publish a current subject-specific count, duration or preparation task.
colleges.note: The generic interview page is still headed 2025. Its general timing is not presented as a confirmed current maths arrangement.

colleges.name: St Edmund’s
colleges.delivery: Online. Mature college: normally 21 or over at entry.
colleges.structure: Usually one maths interview of approximately an hour, with two academics, working on mathematical problems. A separate preparation task is not specified.
colleges.note: The college also has a January application round, whose interview dates differ from the main December round.

colleges.name: St John’s
colleges.delivery: Online.
colleges.structure: Usually two interviews of approximately 25 minutes each with Maths Fellows. Most of the time is spent discussing problems. A separate preparation task is not specified.

colleges.name: Selwyn
colleges.delivery: In person, including overseas applicants.
colleges.structure: Normally two maths interviews. Mathematics with Physics applicants also have a short Physics interview. Maths interview duration and any separate preparation task are not specified.

colleges.name: Sidney Sussex
colleges.delivery: Ordinarily resident in the UK: in person. Overseas: online.
colleges.structure: Maths-specific count and duration are not published in the current guidance reviewed. General college guidance describes one or two interviews; any preparation instructions come with the invitation.
colleges.note: The 2026/27 applicant page is used for delivery. The subject page contains older interview text.

colleges.name: Trinity Hall
colleges.delivery: UK: in person. Overseas: online.
colleges.structure: Two maths interviews of around 25 minutes each, working through problems. A separate preparation task is not specified.

colleges.name: Wolfson
colleges.delivery: Online, using Zoom. Mature college: normally 21 or over at entry.
colleges.structure: General college guidance gives one or two interviews, totalling 40 to 50 minutes. A maths-specific structure or preparation task is not published. The college says it does not provide specimen assessment papers.
colleges.note: Wolfson’s current website offers Mathematics. The timing is college-wide rather than specific to maths.
